name: knowledge-as-code
description: The worked example corpora that ship with knowledge-as-code, each as an installable plugin.

plugins.name: example-libraries
plugins.description: A worked example corpus shipped with knowledge-as-code, holding the invented estate of a fictional public-library consortium. It is here to show what a corpus holds, and it governs nobody.

plugins.name: example-engineering
plugins.description: A worked example corpus shipped with knowledge-as-code, holding the invented governance layer of a fictional engineering organisation. Its policies bind nobody, and no organisation is certified against anything it records.
